analyst_view.overall: A mid-table Segunda game at Butarque on Friday night: Luis Carrión's Leganés (15th, 18 points) against Ferran Costa's Sabadell (14th, 19 points), both about five points above the drop zone. Leganés won 3-1 at Andorra on 20 November for a second league win in a row, but Álvaro Morata, who scored there, went off injured after 70 minutes; FotMob now lists a muscle injury, and the numbers already take about 16% off Leganés' goals for him (my earlier small trim for his doubt is therefore dropped). Sabadell are winless in five, draw a lot (7 of 15) and score little (13 goals), drew 1-1 with Granada last time out, are without Nicholas Gioacchini for the season (counted) and have Arthur doubtful. Both sides have been booked heavily and the numbers already add for it; no referee is named yet, so I stay with the numbers on every stat.

goals.text: The numbers say 1.6 goals, split evenly. Without Morata, Leganés' main attacking reference, and with Sabadell's forward Gioacchini out for the season, both attacks are weakened, and the numbers already take about 16% and 12% off for them. Sabadell's low-scoring, draw-heavy style fits that, so I stay at about 1.6.

corners.text: The numbers say 9.3 corners, split evenly. Both teams have been near their usual corner counts lately and the numbers add a little for it; Sabadell lining up with five at the back may keep the game tight, but that is how they have played all season, so I stay at about 9.3.

cards.text: The numbers say 6.6 cards, already high because Leganés (27 in six) and Sabadell have both been booked a lot recently, and the numbers add 11-16% each for it; Sabadell took four yellows against Granada. No referee is named yet and there is no derby edge, so I stay at about 6.6.

shots.text: The numbers say 26.5 shots, 14.9 for Sabadell, whom Leganés' defence may let shoot often (104 shots conceded in six, and Andorra had 23 shots against them), which the numbers already count. I stay at about 26.5.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 7.9 shots on target, 4.3 for Leganés, whose recent accuracy (33 on target in six) the numbers boost while also taking Morata's absence off their goals. With Morata now in the numbers' list I drop my earlier trim and stay at about 7.9.
